Evaluated its answers against hand-checked experiment results with LLM evaluators and tracing, then served the agent through FastAPI with MLflow tracking inside Docker containers.

paragraphs: I am applying to join the AI & Advanced Analytics team at Halfspace. My work sits where you describe it, between statistics, machine learning and software: more than eight years of building models and, more recently, Generative AI agents that run in production. What ties it together is turning a messy question into a system people can rely on.

Halfspace began by predicting live football matches and now helps companies make better decisions faster, and I like that the edge comes from careful modelling rather than noise. There is a personal reason as well. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Copenhagen together and settle there long term.

I would bring both sides your two units need. At United Health Group I built a LangGraph multi-agent analytics chatbot that cut manual analysis by 98%, with evaluation pipelines that reduced human review by 43%. At Viavi I shipped anomaly detection and Holt-Winters forecasting across 500+ network devices, the statistical side of the same craft.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me honest about building for real users and checking that a tool truly helps them. I would be glad to talk about where I could contribute.
